owner.occupation: Second-year nursing student and grocery clerk

world.bio: Second-year nursing student in Toronto, international student from Cebu. I work night stocking shifts at a grocery store and video-call my grandmother every Sunday. Status on my messages app: "Winter's not even here and I'm already tired." I sing in a Filipino church choir and binge K-dramas on the subway.
skills_assets: Second-year nursing program, clinical placement starting in January
Night stock shift at a grocery store, forklift-adjacent skills, pallet jack certified
Soprano in a Filipino church choir
Fluent in English, Cebuano and Tagalog
A budget spreadsheet, a bus pass and a secondhand laptop

projects.name: Pharmacology midterm recovery
projects.text: Midterm came back at 52%. I need at least 65% on the final to pass the course. I work 25 hours a week night-stocking, so I study on the bus and in the break room.

projects.name: Winter coat fund
projects.text: Saving for a proper winter coat. The one I have is from Cebu, a cotton jacket. I have CAD 90 saved.

notes.text: Night shift. Unloaded 24 pallets of canned tomatoes. My arms ache. Studied pharmacology flashcards in the break room. Cannot remember the difference between ACE inhibitors and ARBs.
Choir practice after Mass. Sang 'Ave Maria'. For ten minutes I forgot about the midterm. Auntie Gloria gave me some pancit to take home.
Midterm result: 52%. I stared at it for a long time. I know the material. I just was too tired in the exam. The prof said come to office hours.
Video call with Lola. She asked if I was eating. I said yes. She asked what. I said rice. She said just rice? I said and egg. She nodded. I did not tell her I skipped lunch.
Sent CAD 400 home to Cebu again. Mama's medicines, my little brother's school fees. I have been skipping lunch to make it work. I eat half a sandwich at the break and call it lunch.
Subway: K-drama marathon on my phone. Four episodes. Cried in the last one. A woman gave me a tissue.
Manager asked if I could take two more shifts. I said I have a quiz. He said ok, next time. I felt bad saying no and bad saying yes.
Winter coat sale flyer. $149. I have $90. I will wait.

messages.text: Mama: Anak, are you eating? Me: Yes Ma. Mama: Your brother needs his tuition by the 30th. Me: I will send. Mama: Do not overwork. Me: I am fine.
Joy: You are coming home late again. Me: Shift ended at 6. Joy: You need sleep. Me: I know.
Prof: Come to office hours Thursday. Me: I have class. Prof: After class then. Me: Okay.
Gloria: Choir needs you on Sunday. Me: I'll try. Gloria: I'll bring food. Me: Thank you po.
Lola: When are you coming home? Me: After graduation. Lola: That is a long time. Me: I know.

relations.about: Cebu, sick with high blood pressure, relies on remittances.
Grandmother, lives in Cebu, video calls every Sunday.

constraints: International student work cap of 24 hours per week (she is at the edge)
Cannot ask her parents for money
Needs to pass pharmacology to stay in program
sensitive: Fears losing her study permit if she fails a course
